title: How signing really works
subtitle: Evidence-backed teardown of an owned Lumin Sign fixture (JS bundle only)
disclaimer: This target is a first-party demo signer we wrote. REA never inspected a third-party or competitor product. Findings are static: syntax observations and relationship inferences, not runtime proof.

flow.title: 1. Field placement
flow.claim: A click on a rendered page becomes a PDF-space rectangle tagged lumin-sign-field:signature, with page-point units and a place-field flow marker.
evidence: trace_application_feature seed lumin-sign-flow:place-field matched the export's static return shape

flow.title: 2. Signature capture
flow.claim: A canvas pad records polyline strokes on pointerdown/pointermove/pointerup and exports image/png via canvas.toDataURL. Empty ink throws lumin-sign-capture-empty.
evidence: Semantic literals pointerdown, pointermove, pointerup, image/png, lumin-sign-capture-empty
Class methods attach, exportPng, clear, isEmpty survived as names
Export SignatureCapture recovered from the ESM export list

flow.title: 3. PDF write
flow.claim: writeSignatureOntoPdf imports pdf-lib, loads the document, embedPngs the captured bytes, and drawImages them onto the placed field.
evidence: Application graph imports edge to static-import:pdf-lib and external:pdf-lib

limitations: CommonJS and ESM binding relationships were recovered from inert syntax and resolved only within the inventoried artifact container.
JavaScript and HTML were parsed as inert text; bundle bootstrap code was never executed.
Static imports, entrypoints, workers, endpoints, and storage relationships do not prove runtime execution.
Static paths and relationships may remain unresolved when expressions are dynamic or obfuscated.
Webpack/Rspack factories were recovered from AST literals; REA did not invoke push handlers or bundle bootstrap code.
notes: analyze_javascript_application parsed 1 JS file, 912 AST nodes, and built a 17-node application graph plus a 608-node semantic relation graph.
inspect_analysis_view projected a summary without repeating analysis.
String traces against the application graph matched some exported return-shape fields and missed other literals that the semantic graph still observed.
electron-main / electron-renderer nodes come from package.json + HTML script tags. This fixture is a browser bundle, not an Electron app.
